invariants.rationale: Method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so the result should not be null.
preppedRecords parameter is used downstream, thus should not be null at method exit.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata usually contains a non-null list of WriteStatus.
The number of write statuses should not exceed the number of records prepared for insert.
instantTime should be a non-null, non-empty string representing the commit time.
